### For Group Comparison Data

```{r}
# shorten name & clean up! 
mapped_comp <- mapped_comp_v3.2.2_EExAge_t1 %>%
  
  filter(is.na(issue)) %>% # keeps rows with issue == na (so comps that are ok)
  filter(!str_detect(log2FC, "Inf")) %>% # remove infinity/missing FC values
  
  # make gene label for significant! 
  mutate(sig_g_label = if_else(adj.pvalue <= .05, gene, NA)) %>%
  
  # make one for no. of sig up & down for each comaprison group/label
  group_by(Label) %>%
  mutate(sig_no_up_lab = sum(adj.pvalue < 0.05 & log2FC > 0), # up
         sig_no_down_lab = sum(adj.pvalue < 0.05 & log2FC < 0)) %>%  #  down
  
  mutate(Direction = ifelse(log2FC > 0, "Up", "Down"))

# check 
head(mapped_comp) 
colnames(mapped_comp)
dim(mapped_comp) # 64384 x 22

unique_check_mapcomp <- mapped_comp %>% 
  dplyr::select(Label, sig_no_down_lab, sig_no_up_lab) %>%
  unique() # yep matches up! 
```

```{r}
# unique(mapped_comp$Label)
# unicodes for up \U2191 & down \U2193
big_volcano <- mapped_comp %>%
  filter(!(Label %in% c("HxA_EE_YNG_vs_SH_OLD", "HxA_EE_OLD_vs_SH_YNG"))) %>% # 6 plot
  
  filter(!(Label %in% c("A_YNG_vs_OLD",
                      "HxA_EE_YNG_vs_EE_OLD", "HxA_SH_YNG_vs_SH_OLD"))) %>%

    # filter(!(Label %in% c("H_EE_vs_SH",
    #                     "HxA_EE_YNG_vs_SH_YNG", "HxA_EE_OLD_vs_SH_OLD"))) %>%

  ggplot(aes(x = log2FC, y = -log10(adj.pvalue), label = sig_g_label)) +
  
  
  #vline & hlines
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05),
             linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.1,
             color = "grey40") +
  annotate("text", x = 1.84, y = -log10(0.05),
           label = "adj.p <.05 \n",
           fontface = 'italic', size = 1.5, color = "grey30") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.1),linetype = "dotted",
             linewidth = 0.15, color = "grey60") +
  annotate("text", x = 1.79, y = -log10(0.1),
           label = " adj.p <.1 \n",
           fontface = 'italic', size = 1.5, color = "grey45") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(0),linetype = "solid",
             linewidth = 0.15, color = "grey75") +
  

  
    # POINTS
  ggrastr::geom_point_rast(aes(color = case_when( # conditional ass for color mapping
    adj.pvalue < 0.05 & log2FC > 0 ~ "up_adjp.05", # up sig .05
    adj.pvalue < 0.05 & log2FC < 0 ~ "down_adjp.05", # down sig .05
    adj.pvalue < 0.1 & log2FC > 0 ~ "up_adjp.1", # up 0.1
    adj.pvalue < 0.1 & log2FC < 0 ~ "down_adjp.1", # down .1
    TRUE ~ "ns" ), alpha = adj.pvalue), # catch the rest
    size = 1.75,
    raster.dpi = getOption("ggrastr.default.dpi", 330)) +
  
  scale_color_manual(values = c("firebrick", # coloring
                                "royalblue3",
                                "lightpink",
                                "lightblue3",
                                "grey80"),
                     breaks = c("up_adjp.05",
                                "down_adjp.05",
                                "up_adjp.1",
                                "down_adjp.1"),
                     labels = c("\U2191 (adj.p <.05)",
                                "\U2193 (adj.p <.05)",
                                "\U2191 (adj.p <.1)",
                                "\U2193 (adj.p <.1)")) +
    scale_alpha(range = c(0.55,0.02), guide = "none") + # more transparent less sig
  
  
  geom_text_repel(max.overlaps = 35, size = 2.2, # gene text on points
                  color = "grey10",
                 segment.size	= 0.2, segment.alpha = 0.5, min.segment.length = 0.5) +
  
  

  
  
  # NUM SIG UP & DOWN! | use sep df, overwise overplots
  geom_text(data = sig_volcano_sum, # up 
            aes(label = paste0(sig_no_up_lab, " \U2191")),
            x = 1.62,
             # y = 7.3, # age/all
             y = 3.5, # EE
            size = 3.6, color = "firebrick"
            ) + 
  geom_text(data = sig_volcano_sum, # down
            aes(label = paste0(sig_no_down_lab, " \U2193")),
            x = -1.62,
             # y = 7.3, # age/all
             y = 3.5, # EE
            size = 3.6, color = "royalblue3"
            ) + 

  xlim(-2,2) +

  # facet_wrap(~Label, ncol = 4) + 
  facet_wrap2(~Label,
                strip = strip_colors,
                # space = "free",
               # scales = "free",
                ncol = 3) +

  labs(x = "log2FC",
       y = "-Log10(adj.p value)",
       color = "Protein Regulation") +
  
  
  guides(color=guide_legend(nrow=1, byrow=TRUE)) +
  
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none", # sex & Housing/ExpH
    # legend.position = "bottom", # cohort
    axis.title = element_text(color = "grey10", size = 9),
    axis.text = element_text(color = "grey10", size = 8),
    legend.title = element_text(color = "grey10", size = 9),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 8, color = "grey10"),
    strip.background = element_rect(color = 'grey10', fill = 'grey90',
                                    linewidth = .3),
     panel.border = element_rect(fill = NA,color = "grey10",linewidth = 0.3), #plot bord
    axis.ticks = element_line(linewidth = .1, colour = "grey15"),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "grey90", linewidth = 0.1),
    panel.grid.minor = element_line(color = "grey97", linewidth = 0.1),
    panel.spacing.y = unit(0.25, "cm"), # vert spacing
    panel.spacing.x = unit(0.25, "cm"), # horizontal spacing - COHORT 
    legend.margin = margin(-5,0,0,0),  # space between plot & legend
```

### For Loops & Functions

Function for boxplots

- <https://github.com/eliocamp/ggnewscale?tab=readme-ov-file>

```{r}
boxplot_function <- function(data, x , y, # function inputs
                             fill = Housing,
                             # alpha = NULL,
                             shape_color = TechRepMixture,
                             shape_fill = NULL,
                             facet_formula = ~Age+Cohort+Litter+Sex , # default
                             # facet_formula = ~Sex+Age+Cohort+Litter, # default
                             legend_pos = "bottom", 
                             title = NULL, # need to set as NULL?
                             subtitle = NULL) {
  
  #set up polot ^ assign 2 p
  p <- ggplot(data, aes({{x}},{{y}},
              # color = {{color}},
              # shape = {{shape}},
              # alpha = {{alpha}}
              )) +
    
    # make box plot
    geom_boxplot(aes(fill = {{fill}}),
                 width = 0.55, size = 0.7, median.linewidth = .4, linewidth = 0.3,
                 position = position_dodge(width = 0.7),
                 outlier.shape = NA,
                 color = "grey10", alpha = 0.7) +
    
    stat_summary(fun=mean, geom="point", position = position_dodge(width = 0.7),
               shape=4, size = .8, stroke = 0.3, color ="grey10") + #displays mean 
    
    # scale_alpha_discrete(guide = 'none', range = c(0.65, 0.75)) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("#66A61EFF", "#E6AB02FF")) + # housing colors 
    # scale_shape_manual(values = c(1, 3, 4)) + # techreplicate (3)
    

    # New SCALE with NEW GEOM 
    ggnewscale::new_scale_fill() +
      geom_point(aes(fill = {{shape_fill}}, color = {{shape_color}}),
      size = 1, shape = 21, stroke = .2, 
      position = position_jitterdodge(dodge.width = 0.4, jitter.width = 0.02)) +
    #2nd scale
    scale_color_manual(values = c("#003a6d","#31135e","#510224")) + # IBM
    scale_fill_manual(values = alpha(c("#eee8d5", "#b58900", "#C06A0B", "#cb4b16",
                                       "#D43F23", "#dc322f", "#D83459", "#d33682",
                                       "#A054A3", "#6c71c4", "#497ECB", "#268bd2",
                                       "#2896B5", "#2aa198", "#589D4C", "#859900",
                                       "#586e75"), 0.5)) + # solarised mix
    
    
    # FACET
    ggh4x::facet_nested(facet_formula) +
    
    labs(title = title, subtitle = subtitle) + # TITLE & SUBTITLE
    
    guides(color = "none",
           fill = guide_legend(nrow=1, byrow=TRUE)) +
    
    # theme (maybe just add theme from above or beeter self contained like this?)
    theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 9, color = "grey10",
                              margin = margin(b = 0.5)),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 8, color = "grey10", face = "italic",
                                 margin = margin(b = 0.5)),
    axis.line = element_blank(),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 9, color = "grey10"), 
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 8, color = "grey10"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 7, color = "grey10"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 7.5, color ="grey10"),
    axis.ticks = element_line(size=0.1, colour = "grey15", linewidth = .2),
    
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "grey97"), #bg of plot (inner)
    plot.margin = margin(t = 1, r = 2, b = 2, l = 2, unit = "pt"),
    panel.border = element_rect(fill = NA, linewidth = .2,
                                color = "grey10"), #plot borders
    # plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white"), # bg of plot (outer)
    # panel.grid = element_blank(),
    panel.spacing = unit(0, "cm"),  # Removes space between panel 
    
    legend.position = legend_pos, # LEGEND POSITON
    
    legend.title = element_text(size = 9, face="italic", color = "grey10"),
    legend.margin = margin(-5,0,0,0), # space between plot & legend
    #legend.title.align = (0.5), # centres legend title
    legend.text = element_text(size = 8.5, color = "grey10"),
    legend.box = "horizontal", 
    legend.direction = "horizontal", 
    legend.key.size = unit(0.5, "cm"), # size of legend key icon
    strip.background = element_rect(color = 'grey10', fill = 'grey92',
                                    linewidth = .2), 
    strip.text.x = element_text(size = 6.5, color = 'grey10',
                                margin = margin(b = 1, t = 1)) #vert spacing
  )
    
}
```

### For Housing per protein

```{r}
EE_main_sig_df <- mapped_comp %>%
  filter(Label == "H_EE_vs_SH" & adj.pvalue < 0.05) %>%
  group_by(Direction) %>%
  arrange(adj.pvalue)


EE_main_p_sig_list <- unique(EE_main_sig_df$Protein)

EE_main_psum_plot_list <- vector(mode = "list")
```

```{r}
for (p in EE_main_p_sig_list){
  
  #SET UP/CALC
  bp_df <- mapped_psum %>% #from psums
  filter(Protein == p) 
  
  bp_labs <- EE_main_sig_df %>% # using the filter mapped_comp list 
    filter(Protein == p) %>%
    dplyr::slice(1) 
  
  obs_in <- mapped_psum %>% #get no. biorep observed
  filter(Protein == p) %>%
    summarise(n_unique = n_distinct(BioReplicate)) %>%
    pull(n_unique)
  
  #________________________
  # MAKE PLOT
  bp <- boxplot_function( 
       data = bp_df,
       x = Housing, 
       y = Abundance,
       fill = Housing,  # by default
       shape_fill = Channel, #de
       shape_color = TechRepMixture,
       legend_pos = "none", # default
       title = paste0(bp_labs$gene, " - ", bp_labs$description),
       subtitle = paste0(bp_labs$Direction, "regulated in EE (",
                         bp_labs$uniprot_acc, " ", bp_labs$database,
                         " - observed in ", obs_in, " samples)")
       )
  
  print(bp)

  #________________
  # SAVIHG PLOTS - separates up vs down regulated
    if (bp_labs$Direction[1] == "Up") {
      EE_main_psum_plot_list$Up[[p]] <- bp

    } else{
      EE_main_psum_plot_list$Down[[p]] <- bp
    }
  
}
```

```{r}
my_psum_facet_theme <- my_theme +
  theme(
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 6.5, color ="grey10"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 5.5, color ="grey10"),
    axis.title.x = element_blank(),
  
    panel.spacing = unit(0.2, "cm"),  # Removes space between panel 
    legend.margin = margin(-5,0,0,0), # space between plot & legend
    legend.key.size = unit(0.5, "cm"), # size of legend key icon,
    axis.ticks = element_line(linewidth = .1, colour = "grey15"),
    panel.border = element_rect(fill = NA,color = "grey10",linewidth = 0.3), #plot bord
    strip.background = element_rect(color = 'grey10', fill = 'grey90',linewidth = .3),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "italic", size = 10.5),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 11.5,  color = "grey10",face = "italic"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 9,  color = "grey10",face = "italic"),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "grey90", linewidth = 0.1),
    panel.grid.minor = element_line(color = "grey95", linewidth = 0.1),
  )
```

```{r}
# EE UP
EE_up_prot_list <- mapped_comp %>%
  filter(Label == "A_YNG_vs_OLD" & adj.pvalue < 0.05 & Direction == "Down") %>%
      slice_min(adj.pvalue, n = 8) %>%
  pull(Protein)

EE_sig_by_PND_line_df <- mapped_psum %>%
   filter(Protein %in% EE_up_prot_list)



EE_sig_by_PND_line_1 <- ggplot(EE_sig_by_PND_line_df,
                               aes(x = PND, y = Abundance,
                                   color = Housing))


EE_sig_by_PND_line_2 <- EE_sig_by_PND_line_1 +
  geom_point(shape=1, size = 0.1) +  
  #geom_point(shape=1, aes(color = read)) +  #colored points
  stat_poly_line(method = "lm", se = TRUE, 
                 size = .5) +
  stat_poly_eq(use_label(c("eq", "R2")),
               size = 3, label.x = 0.95, parse = TRUE) + #label.x = position

  
  scale_color_manual(values = c("#66A61EFF", "#E6AB02FF")) + # housing colors
  scale_alpha_manual(values = c(.65,.8)) +
  # scale_color_manual(values = c("#c90076","#125CCC")) +
  # guides(y.sec = 'axis') + # adds 2nd y axis (right side)
  
  
  facet_grid(Protein~Mixture, scales = "free_y") +
  my_theme +
  theme(
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 7.5, color ="grey10"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 7, color ="grey10"),
    axis.title.x = element_blank(),
    panel.spacing = unit(0.2, "cm"),  # Removes space between panel 
    legend.margin = margin(0,0,10,0), # space between plot & legend
    axis.ticks = element_line(size=0.1, colour = "grey15"),
    panel.border = element_rect(fill = NA,color = "grey10"), #plot borders
    strip.background = element_rect(color = 'grey10', fill = 'grey90'),
      panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "grey95"),
        panel.grid.minor = element_line(color = "grey99"),
    legend.position = "none"
  )
```
